descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-15 Ask AI · S25 Ask AI fails or returns nothing, both contexts: explicit message, no answer, the typed question kept

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U9 Ask AI failed: an explicit error and no invented answer; what the physician typed is kept; the app retries, then the backup model answers or a clear message shows — never waiting with nothing. (UAT Empty & Failure States; UAT 3.5)
  • U4 Answers are grounded only in that patient's data: no cross-patient bleed, no invented information, no outside data; per 3.4 no guessed units on ambiguous values and no narration of documentation stat … (UAT TC-15; TFA-92593 AC 3; UAT 3.4)
  • U8 Works in both Hospital and Nursing Home contexts (ground rule 3.3). (UAT 3.3; TFA-92593 AC 9)

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Make-session fixture; every ai/assist:askChart call fails (cp1–cp2), then every call returns an empty string (cp3–cp4)

When Type "What is the latest potassium?" (not a preset label) and tap Ask AI on Hospital Pre-Round, NH Encounter, Hospital Encounter and NH Pre-Round

Then Failed call: the 'couldn’t be reached … tap Ask AI again' copy; empty reply: the 'returned no answer' copy; no 'Patient Record' answer block, no lab value, not stuck on 'Searching…', the typed question still in the box

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): From U9: each checkpoint mustContain 'latest potassium' (question kept) and its failure copy; mustNotContain 'Patient Record', 'Searching', 'WBC', 'mmol', 'mEq'. Same case as EFS S10 / OAT-03 S06: run once, report under all three

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method FAULT · Fault injection; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S25 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-15.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16/17 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: FAULT · Fault injection; secondary: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: newspec-c.

UAT item: TC-15 Ask AI · Section: A3 · Encounter · Scenario: TC-15/S25

Ask AI fails or returns nothing, both contexts: explicit message, no answer, the typed question kept

Tickets: TFA-92593 Ask AI (ready for qa)

New local lane newspec-c: status passed in newspec-c/results.json → passed (passed).

Detail:

Spec newspec-c/flt-tc15-s25-ask-fail.spec.ts. ai/assist:askChart fails at the socket (cp1 Hospital Pre-Round, cp2 Nursing Home Encounter), then returns an empty string (cp3 Hospital Encounter, cp4 Nursing Home Pre-Round). Judged 16/16 (the failed-call checkpoints): 'The chart assistant couldn’t be reached, so there is no answer. Nothing shown here is a stand-in. Check your connection and tap Ask AI again.', 'What is the latest potassium?' still in the box, no 'Patient Record' answer block, not on 'Searching…', no WBC / mmol / mEq. Recorded (our addition, the empty reply): 'The assistant returned no answer for this question. Try asking it another way.', question kept, nothing else shown. Cross-reference: when the network itself is down (EFS/S14) the same Ask stays on 'Searching…' until the connection returns; that is judged under EFS/S14.

Evidence: 6 attached.

Dev run: skipped: not runnable on dev — not-runnable-on-dev: fault-ai. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
